scope: Frozen all-synthetic and all-exposed diagnostic regression; not independent acceptance

query_rule.method: Frozen deterministic deletion of interrogative words in keyword route only, replaced by spaces to avoid invented CJK bigrams
query_rule.suffix: 吗 only immediately before clause punctuation or end
query_rule.preserved: Numbers, Latin identifiers, negation, condition phrases, whether/can and duration/quantity words remain; semantic and rerank always use original query
query_rule.fallback: Quoted/code/bracketed input, length over512 or fewer than2 remaining letters/numbers: original query

budgets.raw_cap: 90 keyword selected from up to180 body/context hits;45 semantic
budgets.calls_per_scored_request: 2 Elasticsearch keyword searches,1 vector search,1 query embedding; identical in both modes

selection: Compare individual pool and keyword evidence gains/losses, then final Top5 side effects. No change to questions, gold, indexed text, model, chunking, fusion or reranking. Density of annotated evidence is not precision; gold is not exhaustive relevance annotation.
stop_rules: One pass through both frozen modes; no rule tuning after scores
Do not adopt without stable pool evidence gain and zero evidence regressions; no business default switch
If no stable gain, record limitations and stop this direction
http_parity: Verify original unsplit diagnostic path against existing HTTP at 15:15; query transformations remain internal experiments and do not claim HTTP split-path parity
timings: One serial pass; no production latency/throughput claim
